scientific_scope: A bounded offline active-learning simulation on frozen ODAC23 S2EF DFT labels. It measures energy and force prediction against that reference only, not adsorption thermodynamics or experimental adsorption.

source.dataset: ODAC23 S2EF validation 80-trajectory stratified derived subset
source.guest_filter: CO2=1, H2O=0; other guests remain outside this first controlled pilot

group_split.unit: parent MOF parsed from ODAC configuration name before _w_

arms.A_random_frozen: Freeze foundation model. Record random acquisition but perform no model update.
arms.B_random_finetune: Select equal-sized batches by a fixed seeded random policy and fine-tune after every acquisition batch.
arms.C_diagnostic_frozen: Use predeclared force-risk diagnostics to select equal-sized batches, but do not fine-tune.
arms.D_diagnostic_finetune: Use only predeclared foundation-model force-risk diagnostics to select equal-sized batches; fine-tune after every batch.

promotion_gate.selection_visibility: No ODAC reference energy or force may be read by an acquisition policy.
promotion_gate.final_reporting: Read final-holdout labels only once after arm configurations are frozen.
promotion_gate.interpretation: This small single-seed pilot is feasibility evidence, not a statistical performance claim.
